packet.claim: The recovery check rejects a valid rewritten text as INVALID_INSTANTIATION because the text is not a grammar cell, even though recover_json_object is defined on arbitrary text and should return the fenced object.
packet.execution_evidence: executed: INVALID_INSTANTIATION, expect: unchanged, detail: the rewritten text is no cell of the grammar
packet.expected: Recovery returns the fenced object {"a":1} (unchanged) because a code fence holds an object and the rule prefers the last object inside a code fence over later top-level objects.
packet.observed: The test harness reports INVALID_INSTANTIATION with detail 'the rewritten text is no cell of the grammar' instead of evaluating recovery.
packet.scope: Recovery inputs where a fenced JSON object is followed by prose and then a top-level JSON object, and the combined text is not accepted by the test grammar.
packet.source_basis: The object scored is the last one inside a code fence when any fence holds one, else the last top-level object in the text
packet.uncertainty: The documented rules do not state that recovery inputs must be grammar cells; if the harness intentionally restricts to cells, that restriction is not documented here.
